feature_title: AI Observability Header Redesign (Last-Refreshed Indicator + Labeled Refresh Button)

rationale.edition: Both OSS and enterprise paths are changed. OSS paths (13 files): web/src/components/O2AIChat.vue, web/src/components/common/KpiCardRow.vue, web/src/composables/dashboard/usePanelDataLoader.ts, web/src/layouts/MainLayout.vue, web/src/plugins/traces/* (6 files), web/src/utils/dashboard/* (2 files). Enterprise paths (25 files): web/src/enterprise/components/AIObservability/AiPageShell.vue and AiLastRefreshed.vue (new), web/src/enterprise/components/OnlineEvals.vue, web/src/enterprise/components/onlineEvals/* (16 files including quality sub-components), web/src/enterprise/views/AIObservability/* (5 files). No enterprise-only keywords in OSS paths — the OSS files are generic UI components and utilities. The enterprise paths are under the web/src/enterprise/ directory which is the definitive enterprise boundary.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. No explicit opt-out — both feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are empty, and no 'tests-added' label or skip instruction was provided. The change is clearly user-facing: it modifies the AI Chat panel (O2AIChat send button variant/icon, history search input, welcome screen, chat panel width), redesigns AI Observability page headers (new AiLastRefreshed staleness indicator, labeled primary Refresh button replacing compact ORefreshButton), restructures LLM panel chrome (new LLMPanelCard shared container), and reworks SessionsList columns and sortability. These are all visible UI changes that users interact with.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The changes alter user-visible UI interactions across multiple product surfaces. The O2AIChat send button changed from 'ai-gradient' variant with 'send' icon to 'primary' variant with 'arrow-upward' icon — a visual and behavioral change users will notice. The chat history search input was restructured from a wrapper div to a standalone OSearchInput with different CSS layout. The MainLayout chat panel width behavior changed from fixed-position overlay (full-screen mode) to a side-by-side card at 50% width. On the AI Observability pages, the header toolbar now shows an AiLastRefreshed component (staleness dot + relative time) and a labeled primary 'Refresh' button — the refresh interaction flow should be verified. The LLMPanelCard replaces hand-rolled card headers across LLMErrorTable and LLMSchemaPanel — the consolidated card rendering should be verified. SessionsList columns were reordered and sortability was added to multiple columns — the table interaction should be verified.
rationale.area: AIObservability — a new area. The most cohesive structural change is the introduction of AiLastRefreshed and the header toolbar redesign on AiPageShell and OnlineEvals, both under web/src/enterprise/ (enterprise-only). No existing Playwright test area under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ matches 'AIObservability'. The enterprise CI matrix (ci_matrix.ent.json) has groups for GeneralTests, Logs-Core, Logs-Features, Pipelines, Traces, Workflows, SDR-Logs, and SDR-Traces — none cover AI Observability pages. This is a new product surface that warrants its own test area.
rationale.group: AIObservability — a new matrix group. The enterprise CI matrix overlay (ci_matrix.ent.json) has no shard for AI Observability. The Engineer will need to add a new shard entry under 'shards': { 'testfolder': 'AIObservability', 'actual_folder': 'AIObservability', 'browser': 'chrome', 'run_files': ['aiPageHeader.spec.js'], 'disabled': [] }. This matches the pattern of other enterprise-only shards like Workflows and SDR-Logs.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/enterprise/components/AIObservability/AiPageShell.spec.ts, which is a Vitest unit test — not a Playwright E2E spec. No files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ were added or modified. The Vitest unit spec was updated to match the component API changes (stub changed from ORefreshButton to AiLastRefreshed, test assertions updated for new labeled Refresh button) but does not provide end-to-end coverage of the user-facing UI flows.
